email.body1:
Naresh, saw Datasaur expand LLM Lab to over 250 models while partnering with names like Google.

Momentum like that usually opens more co-sell and alliance targets than a growth team can personally work before the window closes, and that is where partner-sourced pipeline stalls. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner ecosystem autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play mapping Datasaur's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Naresh, quick follow-up for Datasaur.

Most alliances leaders know their co-sell motion works but cannot personally touch every partner or joint account that fits, so warm intros sit cold and the channel underdelivers. The fix is rarely more headcount, it is faster signal-to-touch on accounts already in motion.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body3:
Naresh, last bit of proof for Datasaur.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a pipeline gap analysis on what partner-sourced coverage could look like for Datasaur. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Naresh, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Expanding an LLM platform and the alliances around it is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner ecosystem? I will tailor it to Datasaur either way.
